title: Reproducibility materials for “Evaluating synthetic clinical data for future realizations and hospitals”
description: Public analysis software, approved aggregate source data, minimal simulated replicate-level E3/E5 reproduction inputs, final R2 manuscript displays, Supplementary Data 1–10, display-reproduction scripts and fabricated tests. No patient-level clinical or evaluated synthetic data, patient predictions, fitted clinical models, hospital identifiers, restricted hospital-indexed derivatives, private covariance assets or resampling indices are distributed. Full E1 clinical-source reconstruction requires independently authorized database access and restricted dependencies.
